== Update April 15, 2026 ==

Please accept my deepest apologies. The login screen says the [[Anniversary Celebration|anniversary event]] will start today, April 15th, but it will actually start April 22nd this year, 2026. (We started it a week earlier last year for the big 20th anniversary and forgot to change the text back.)

==Guild Wars Wiki notes==
This announcement was made by [[Stephen Clarke-Willson|Dr. Stephen Clarke-Willson]].
